_readme: Chunking arms for the transcript/chunker experiment (branch chunking). Run order is
cheapest hypothesis first; each arm is roughly 8-9 h, so C1 and P2 are marked
"_optional": run them only if C0/P1/C2 show a signal. Every arm reingests, so the run
clears the LightRAG store it points at: run this file against a second stack
(--lightrag-url/--gateway-url/--env-file) or pass --allow-production deliberately.
chunking.params keys are exactly the names Hermes read out of the LightRAG 1.5.7
image (docs/ops/runs/chunker-experiments.md): chunk_token_size is shared;
recursive_character takes chunk_overlap_token_size and separators;
semantic_vector takes NO overlap key, plus breakpoint_threshold_type,
breakpoint_threshold_amount and buffer_size. sentence_split_regex is env-only and is
rejected in a request. LightRAG answers an unknown key, a bool-as-int or a numeric
string with a synchronous 422; the loop refuses the same shapes before starting an arm.
Docs: docs/ops/runs/chunker-experiments.md, app/transcript_prep.py.
Second-stack run (flags only, no secrets; run from the repo root):
scripts/overnight_loop.py --root ~/rag-project --experiments docs/ops/loop/experiments-chunking.json
--out ~/rag-project/loop-chunking --max-hours 11
--lightrag-url http://127.0.0.1:9631 --gateway-url http://127.0.0.1:8030
--lightrag-container stack2-lightrag-server --gateway-container stack2-rag-gateway-api
--gateway-service gateway-api --lightrag-service lightrag-server --worker-container none
--compose-file ~/rag-project/compose.stack2.yml --compose-project stack2
--env-file ~/rag-project/stack2.env
Never run this file against production without --allow-production; it wipes the store.
--worker-container none is only valid for a stack with no ingest worker: against the
production LightRAG the loop refuses it, because that guard is what stops a clear
underneath a running rag-ingest-worker.

experiments.name: C0-baseline
experiments._note: No chunking key and no transcript_prep: LightRAG's fixed-token default (1200/100) on raw corpus text.

experiments.name: P1-transcript-prep
experiments._note: Same chunker as C0, but every file goes through app.transcript_prep first (turns + context headers). Isolates the text change from the chunker change.

experiments.name: C2-semantic-vector
experiments._note: Semantic breakpoints instead of fixed 1200-token cuts. Note the absence of chunk_overlap_token_size: semantic_vector rejects it (422).

experiments.name: C1-recursive-character
experiments._note: Run only if C0/P1/C2 show a signal. Recursive character splitting with the production sizes.

experiments.name: P2-prep-plus-semantic
experiments._note: Run only if P1 and C2 each helped: prepared text plus the C2 semantic_vector params, to see whether the two gains stack.
